raw_segments.text: Miss Kennedy served two gentlemen with tankards of cool stout.
It was indeed, first gentleman said, beautiful weather.
Did she know where the Lord Lieutenant was going?
And heard steel hoofs ring hoof ring?
No she couldn't say, but it would be in the paper.
She waved about her outspread independent, searching the Lord Lieutenant, her pinnacles
of hair slow moving, Lord Lieutenant.
Too much trouble, first gentleman said.
Way he looked that, Lord Lieutenant, gold by bronze heard iron steel.
